page_title: BRE 1-1 EVE | Brentford v Everton 26/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The ball falls kindly for Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
90+5' PENALTY APPEAL by Brentford, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+1' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
89' The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
88' That's a clear yellow card. Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) goes into the book.

88' Beto (Everton) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Mark Flekken makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the right side of the target.
86' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:3.
86' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mark Flekken has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
84' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) commits a rough foul. Simon Hooper stops the game and makes a call.
81' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer will be replaced by Michael Kayode (Brentford).
80' What was Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
77' 1 - 1 Vitali Mykolenko showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jake O'Brien (Everton) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 1:1.
76' The game has come to an end for Kevin Schade. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Paris Maghoma (Brentford).
75' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ashley Young (Everton) replacing Jesper Lindstrom.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) is coming onto the pitch as Idrissa Gueye cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Brentford are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
71' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
69' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has a goal ruled out for offside!
69' 8:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
66' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
66' Jack Harrison (Everton) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
64' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
63' Everton keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
61' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
59' Dangerous play by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford). Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Jack Harrison (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
55' Jack Harrison (Everton) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
52' James Garner (Everton) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
52' A lofted cross from Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
50' James Garner (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' Jack Harrison (Everton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Simon Hooper blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) blazes well wide of the right post.
45+4' 1 - 0 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
45+4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has a great chance to score, but he heads the ball onto the crossbar!
45+4' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
45+1' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The game is interrupted now, Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Jack Harrison (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
42' Beto (Everton) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Mark Flekken.
41' A rebound bounces out to Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
39' Beto (Everton) dribbles into the box, but Mark Flekken is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
35' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
34' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' A spell of possession for Brentford in an attempt to control the game.
28' Beto (Everton) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
27' Everton are seeing far more of the ball now.
24' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
22' 12:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
19' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.

18' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Jordan Pickford pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
15' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
14' A dangerous looking corner kick from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' Brentford take a short corner kick.
10' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
7' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
4' James Garner (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
3' Brentford are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper was nominated as the referee for this game.
